decision: Adopt the Pilot 2-C floor-and-identity certification experiment, defined by docs/PHASE_8_PILOT2C_AMENDMENT.md, for the exact grid in scope and for nothing else. The amendment changes REV4 section 10.8 only; REV4, D1 and D2 remain unchanged.

owner_decisions.text: Adopt Pilot 2-C floor-and-identity certification using the exact section 2.2 scope and section 2.4 prohibitions of the re-scoping proposal.
Exclude C and C_prime. Do not construct randomized graphs. Do not accept or weaken G3/B7.
Use artifact-based readout provisioning and the A-2 loader-contract amendment. Pilot seeds remain independent of campaign seeds. Never use A-3.
U7 remains open. sigma_max is not evaluable. Do not select N or modify design.n_seeds_selected.
Record U1-B as applicable using Pilot 1 and Pilot 2-C evidence.
Accept that the report may be valid but non-freeze because of the existing protected-baseline drift. Do not restore or modify protected files.
Use manifest-level stage_purpose = floor_and_identity_certification. Do not change the episode-row schema.

prohibitions: do not add C, C_prime or D to the grid
do not construct, read or substitute a randomized graph
do not accept, resolve or weaken the G3 section 9.3 deviation
do not estimate C1-C4, H1-H3, paired dispersion or sigma_max
do not discharge U7 or set design.n_seeds_selected
do not create, train, retrain or substitute a model artifact
do not persist synthetic or initialized state in a pilot row
do not write a pilot row under the campaign results root
do not merge pilot rows into the campaign dataset
do not change an episode-row field, frozen parameter or statistical constant
do not modify REV4, D1 or D2
do not derive authorisation from the stage's own output
does_not_authorise: any grid other than the one in scope
any change to a frozen parameter or statistical constant
